final: WITH account_avgs AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_amount FROM account_avgs) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.avg_amount, aa.avg_amount - om.mean_amount as difference FROM account_avgs aa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE aa.avg_amount > om.mean_amount ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
